summary: DeFi Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated November 5, 2026, announcing that its subsidiary Valour launched eight new SEK-denominated digital asset ETPs on Sweden's Spotlight Stock Market, which began trading the same day. The products track Venice (VVV), Canton Network (CC), Raydium (RAY), Morpho (MORPHO), Maple Finance (SYRUP), Pump.fun (PUMP), Dogwifhat (WIF) and Bonk (BONK), each carrying a 1.9% management fee. This is an ordinary product-launch disclosure, not a special situation; no transaction terms, board recommendation or advisors are stated. No deal or risk-arb angle applies.
